blocks.text: Stances and modes: how your ships choose their fights.
Each warship also has a Stance (the three buttons under Mode): whether, and how far, it chases enemies on its own.
Its Mode shapes the fight within that, and your orders always win.
A small square beside the Mode dot marks any stance other than Aggressive.
Aggressive  Chases any enemy near its weapon range for as long as it can see it, then returns. Every new ship, and every AI ship, starts here; the game is balanced around it.
Defensive  As Aggressive, but on its own never strays far from where it was parked.
Stand Ground  Holds its spot and turns to fire at anything in range: no closing, kiting or dodging. Move and attack orders still work, and it holds wherever they leave it.
A Defensive ship never chases past its leash, whatever its Mode. Attack orders ignore the leash.
Where each Mode fights, as a share of weapon range. Swarm runs between two marks; Evasive also dodges.
Each warship has a Mode, set with the buttons in its panel, that shapes how it fights once engaged.
Move orders still go exactly where you send them. A colored dot under the chevrons marks any Mode other than Standard.
Standard  Engages at max range and holds: moves in until every gun reaches the target, then stops. It doesn't chase; it closes again only once the target leaves its reach. New ships start here.
Swarm  Strafing runs: flies at the target at full speed, firing, then turns back in at speed. Needs Strafing Runs.
Jinks against fast rounds. Needs Omni Thrusters.
